    Frequently Asked Questions
    From basic inquiries to intricate details, we've collated the most common queries from our user base.
    What is your return policy?
    How long does shipping take?
    Do you ship internationally?
    What is your return policy?
    What payment methods do you accept?
    How do I contact customer support?
    What is your return policy?

    We offer a 30-day return policy on all products. Items must be in original condition with tags attached.

    To start a return, you can contact us at admin@techrecomm.com Please note that returns will need to be sent to the following address:

    Tech Recommerce Solutions Inc
    2727 Coney Island Ave Ste C5
    Brooklyn, NY 11235-5004

    If your return is accepted, we’ll send you a return shipping label, as well as instructions on how and where to send your package. Items sent back to us without first requesting a return will not be accepted.


    How long does shipping take?

    Delivery times vary by destination. Orders are typically processed within 1 business day and shipped via trusted carriers.

    Usually, for US orders it takes 2-3 business days, and for worldwide it can take up to 14 days.

    Do you ship internationally?

    Yes, we ship to most countries worldwide. International shipping times vary by location.

    Fast shipping for US
    Worldwide shipping cost is $15 per order

    What is your return policy?

    Yes! - all our devices include a 1-year limited warranty covering manufacturing defects and hardware malfunctions under normal use.


    How do I claim my warranty?

    If you experience any issues, please contact us at admin@techrecomm.com with your order number, a description of the problem, and (if possible) photos or videos.

    Our team will review your claim and provide a repair, replacement, or refund based on the situation.

    What payment methods do you accept?

    We accept all major credit cards, PayPal, Apple Pay, and Google Pay.

    How do I contact customer support?

    You can contact us at admin@techrecomm.com

    Or through our social media: TikTok, Instagram

    Please include your order number and explain your concern in your first message so we can proceed more quickly.
